signals_info.description: Normalized collision risk for the selected pedestrian or cyclist.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some future time, the condition vulnerable_road_user_risk > 0.7 shall newly become true.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在未来某个时刻，vulnerable_road_user_risk > 0.7 这一条件应刚开始成立。
nl_Paraphrase_en: At some future time, the assessed pedestrian-or-cyclist risk shall rise above 0.7.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在未来某个时刻，行人或骑行者风险评估值应升至 0.7 以上。
